title: Beautiful Chair!
text: Beautiful Chair!. This is a beautiful chair. I love how it doesn't look like most ugly desk chairs. My husband put it together for me. He said it wasn't really difficult, but there were a couple of parts that could have been better designed. But overall, he said it was a fine chair. The finished chair looks great! It's a firm seat, which I prefer. It keeps me sitting straight which I am happy with.

product_metadata.title: Home Office Desk and Chair - Mid-Century Modern Swivel Chair with Iron Casters, Suitable for Office Use Without Armrests Cute Modern Task Chair Grey
features: 【FREE HEIGHT ADJUSTMENT】Adjust the height you want at will, you can easily adjust the seat height between 31.1"-42.72" to meet your exact postural needs. The plush, high-density foam seat cushion will maximize your fatigue.

【MULTI-PURPOSE TASK CHAIR】This chair is as versatile as a computer chair. Compact and beautiful in appearance, it has many uses outside the home office, from a reading chair to a great place to sit and put on makeup. Its sleek look is more like a regular piece of furniture than an office chair, giving your desk and chairs a fresh look.

【EASY TO MOVE CHAIR】The seats can swivel 360 degrees, making them more flexible in use as they allow for extra movement rather than having to awkwardly twist while sitting. the PU material casters move easily and will not damage your floors, carpets. If you suffer from lower back pain, then this chair will reduce any stress when you need to walk around while sitting.

【MID-CENTURY MODERN CHAIR】Neutral and sophisticated, this lovely office chair will fit nicely in any space. Plus, it has everything you want in a high-quality office chair, with an adjustable height, ergonomic design, a fluted upholstered back for an elegant touch, a five-star base that can hold up to 250 pounds, and durable casters.

【EASY TO ASSEMBLE】Delivered in a compact box with instructions and accessories, all screws and tools are included so you don't need to find matching tools to complete the installation. The instructions allow you to easily assemble this chair in 10-15 minutes.
description: The newly upgraded 360 degree swivel upholstered chair will be a classic focal point in your house. This fresh color will never go out of style. Enjoy the mobility that comes with the 360 degree swivel system while the PU casters are designed to keep your beautiful floors scratch free. The foam padded and polyester upholstered seat is distinctive. The full backrest provides excellent comfort for your body. Are you looking for a stylish looking office chair for your modern décor? Try this accent desk chair to add stylish appeal to your writing desk or parlor seating set.
